blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Local stocks fell to a fresh six-and-a-half-year low on Thursday as losses in five of six sectors outweighed modest foreign buying. The benchmark Philippine Stock Exchange Index (PSEi) shed 33.93 points, or 0.62 percent, to close at 5,477.91. The broader All Shares index slipped 0.66 percent to 3,079.08.
